mechanism.claim: When BTC spot and perpetual complete the same five-minute auction with opposite return signs and the absolute cross-market return divergence is extreme relative to its own causal history, cash and leverage disagree about price discovery. During elevated BTC variation, follow the cash-market direction while the perpetual resolves toward spot over eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed spot five-minute return
mechanism.why_distinct: Basis transition uses hourly average price-level residuals; error correction fits spread responses; spot displacement and first-passage use multi-hour dominance or barrier timing; sign-transition leadership counts lagged categorical transitions. HVCSDR uses one simultaneous completed five-minute opposite-sign close disagreement and the causal tail of its absolute return difference. It uses no regression, basis level, flow, volume, high/low excursion, funding, OI, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: causal trailing perpetual 24-hour realized variation must occupy its upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: irregular extreme actual-market opposite-sign close disagreements are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: every exact UTC five-minute boundary D
features.market_bars: five exact coherent native one-minute BTCUSDT perpetual and spot rows [D-5m,D)
features.disagreement: spot_return and perpetual_return have opposite strict signs
features.absolute_divergence: absolute value of spot_return minus perpetual_return
features.divergence_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 8640 jointly valid decisions, minimum 6048, current excluded; rank>=0.995
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact perpetual one-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 8640 jointly valid decisions, minimum 6048, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.onset: full directional disagreement true now and false at immediately prior exact source-valid five-minute decision; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after both completed bars and causal ranks are available
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no market, bar, return, disagreement, rank history, rank threshold, variation, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
